definition_english: The permissible span or tolerance of exposure variation (exposure latitude) within which a photographic film, imaging sensor, or radiographic medium records acceptable tonal detail without severe overexposure or underexposure.
definition_hindi: उद्भासन के परिवर्तन की वह स्वीकार्य सीमा या सहनशीलता (उद्भासन छूट), जिसके भीतर कोई फोटोग्राफिक फिल्म, अंतरिक्ष इमेजिंग संवेदक या रेडियोग्राफी माध्यम स्वीकार्य तान-विवरण अंकित कर सकता है।

etymology.root: lātitūdō (breadth, width) from lātus (broad, wide; Old Latin stlātus), PIE *stele- (to spread)
etymology.semantic_development: Derived from the figurative sense of permissible margin or tolerance (broad room for variation), specialized in photography, space imaging, and radiography as exposure tolerance.

hindi.declension: Compound noun phrase headed by consonant-ending feminine noun छूट (व्यंजनान्त स्त्रीलिंग)
hindi.adjective_agreement: Head noun छूट governs feminine agreement (अधिक उद्भासन छूट, उद्भासन छूट दी जाती है/होती है)

usage_restrictions: Must not be translated as उद्भासन सीमा, which refers to a regulatory occupational or radiation exposure limit rather than imaging tonal tolerance.
Must not be translated as अक्षांश (geographic/astronomical coordinate) or विवेकाधिकार (legal/administrative discretion).
Use the full compound उद्भासन छूट wherever bare छूट could be misread as administrative permission or commercial discount.

linguistic_analysis.gender_agreement: The compound उद्भासन छूट takes feminine (स्त्रीलिंग) grammatical agreement, governed by its head noun छूट.
linguistic_analysis.hybrid_register: Combines the technical Sanskrit-derived modifier उद्भासन (exposure) with the head noun छूट (allowance/tolerance).

conceptual_analysis.core_concept: Permissible technical margin of exposure variation in photography, space imaging, and radiography that still preserves usable tonal information.
conceptual_analysis.neighbor_boundaries: Strictly distinct from exposure limit (उद्भासन सीमा), which denotes a maximum safe regulatory ceiling in occupational or radiation safety; also distinct from geographic latitude (HAT-003-S1), astronomical latitude (HAT-003-S2), and legal-administrative latitude (HAT-003-S3).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote an allowable margin or tolerance and share the feminine head noun छूट.
pairwise_comparison.difference: उद्भासन छूट explicitly restricts the reference to photographic, radiographic, or space-imaging exposure tolerance, whereas bare छूट is highly polysemous across administrative permission (HAT-003-S3) and commercial discount/rebate.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not freely interchangeable; उद्भासन छूट is required on first mention or in stand-alone technical glossaries, while bare छूट is usable only after the imaging context is firmly established.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both are feminine technical compounds sharing the modifier उद्भासन (exposure) and appear in scientific/radiographic settings.
pairwise_comparison.difference: उद्भासन छूट renders 'exposure latitude' (permissible tonal variation in imaging media), whereas उद्भासन सीमा renders 'exposure limit' (maximum permissible safety threshold for radiation or occupational exposure).
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Never interchangeable; substituting उद्भासन सीमा for उद्भासन छूट alters a technical imaging specification into a safety ceiling.
